classification_rule.execution_assembly: matched commit position or effective_rank differs from model_rank, or the matched proposal was folded without rank inheritance
classification_rule.fallback_default: matched event rank_basis=deterministic_fallback or model_rank is null
classification_rule.model_ranking: explicit model_selection rank > 1 and commit position == effective_rank == model_rank (fold inheritance, if any, only moves the candidate up)
classification_rule.unknown: payload missing, matched event not unique, or missing fields
